name: A House Divided
description: 12 April 1861: Confederate guns open on Fort Sumter and the American Civil War begins. Italy has just been proclaimed a kingdom, Prussia and Austria contend for Germany, Napoleon III looks to Mexico, the Taiping hold Nanjing against the Qing and Japan's shogunate totters.
approximations: Borders follow modern admin-1 provinces, so each province goes to whoever held most of it in April 1861. The Confederacy starts with the seven states of February 1861; Virginia, North Carolina, Tennessee and Arkansas start in the Union and join the Confederacy by an opening event (West Virginia, Kentucky, Missouri, Maryland and Delaware stay Union; Indian Territory is drawn as Union). The US western territories, the Great Plains held in fact by Native nations, Rupert's Land and British Columbia (Hudson's Bay Company and Crown colony, drawn as British), Russian Alaska, Australia's unsettled interior and New Zealand's Maori-held districts are given to the states that claimed them. Natal is not shown: KwaZulu-Natal is one province and goes to the Zulu Kingdom. The German Confederation's minor states are merged: Württemberg with Baden, Saxony with the Thuringian duchies, Hanover with Oldenburg, Brunswick, Mecklenburg and the Hanseatic cities, the Hesses with Nassau and Frankfurt; Rhineland-Palatinate goes to Prussia and Schleswig-Holstein (with Hamburg) to Denmark. Princely India is merged into British India except Hyderabad and Jammu and Kashmir (British subjects); the Ionian Islands (a British protectorate) and Austrian Mantua are too small to draw; Austria holds Venetia as the Udine province and Trentino-South Tyrol as Bozen, and the Papal States are Lazio. The Taiping hold Jiangsu and Anhui. Spain holds Santo Domingo (re-annexed March 1861), Mindanao and Sulu are drawn as Spanish, Siam's Lao and northern Malay vassals and Battambang-Siem Reap are folded into Siam, and Cambodia is a Siamese subject. Lands without states of the period are left unowned: most of interior Africa (including the Yoruba, Benin, Kongo, Lunda, Luba and Lozi polities, which are too fragmented to draw), Patagonia, the Chaco, Araucania, the Turkmen and Pamir lands, Asir, Hadramawt, the Rub al-Khali, New Guinea, Arunachal, the Naga and Mizo hills and the Pacific islands other than Hawaii, Tonga and French Polynesia and New Caledonia. Population (millions) and GDP (billions of 1990 international dollars) are rounded Maddison-style estimates including colonies, and are especially uncertain outside Europe and the Americas; army sizes are rounded start strengths (the Union and the Confederacy only beginning to mobilise). Ongoing internal wars in Colombia and Venezuela, the Nian and Muslim rebellions in China, the Circassian war and the Banjarmasin war are not modelled. Flags are simplified patterns.

names: Aisén del General Carlos Ibáñez del Campo
